blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The standard Transformer architecture relies on a rigid pattern that alternates Attention and Feed-Forward Network (FFN) layers. Despite its widespread adoption, the inductive bias imposed by this strict separation has not been systematically examined. In this work, we investigate the necessity of the Attention–FFN dichotomy in Vision Transformers (ViTs). To facilitate this analysis, we introduce the AttenFeed module, a unified component that integrates the functional properties of both Attention and FFN. Based on this module, we devise the unified Vision Transformer (uViT), which replaces the conventional alternating Attention–FFN structure with a sequence of AttenFeed modules. We then use uViT as a control group that relaxes the Attention–FFN dichotomy of the standard ViT and systematically compare the two models across multiple datasets and model scales. Our experiments reveal that the Attention–FFN dichotomy can hinder performance at smaller model scales due to the rigid parameter allocation of ViTs. The AttenFeed module and uViT serve as new analytical tools for understanding the Attention–FFN structure and offer theoretical insights into the heuristically designed architecture of conventional ViTs.
blocks.zh: 标准变形器架构依赖于一个刚性图案来替代注意和Feed-Forward Network (FFN)层. 尽管它得到广泛采用,但这种严格分离所强加的诱导性偏见没有得到系统的审查。 在这项工作中,我们调查了视觉变换器(ViTs)中关注-FFN二分法的必要性. 为了方便这一分析,我们引入了AttenFeed模块,这个统一组件融合了注意力和FFN的功能特性. 基于这个模块,我们设计了统一的Vision Transformer(uViT),它用AttenFeed模块的序列取代了传统的交替关注-FFN结构. 然后我们使用uViT作为控制组,放松标准ViT的注意-FFN二分法,并系统比较两个模型跨越多个数据集和模型尺度. 我们的实验表明,由于ViTs的刚性参数分配,注意力-FFN二分法可以阻碍在更小的模型尺度上的性能. AttenFeed模块和uViT作为新的分析工具,用以理解关注-FFN结构,并提供关于常规ViTs的全神贯注设计架构的理论见解.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The Transformer architecture ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) has demonstrated exceptional performance across diverse domains, establishing itself as a universal architecture ( Devlin et al., 2019 ; Achiam et al., 2023 ; Dosovitskiy, 2020 ; Radford et al., 2021 ; Peebles and Xie, 2023 ; Baevski et al., 2020 ; Jumper et al., 2021 ) . Although originally developed for machine translation, it is highly encouraging that the Transformer exhibits robust performance even in disparate fields. In particular, Vision Transformer (ViT) ( Dosovitskiy, 2020 ) has achieved results surpassing those of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) ( LeCun et al., 1998 ; Krizhevsky et al., 2012 ; He et al., 2016 ) , which had long served as the de facto standard in the computer vision domain.
blocks.zh: "变形金刚"建筑(Vaswani等,2017年)展现出跨越不同领域的出色表现,将自己确立为通用建筑(Devlin等,2019年;Achiam等,2023年;Dosovitskiy等,2020年;Radford等,2021年;Peebles等,2023年;Baevski等,2020年;Jumper等,2021年). 虽然最初是为机器翻译而开发的,但非常令人鼓舞的是,变形器即使在不同的领域也表现出强劲的性能。 特别是"视觉变形"(ViT)(多索维特斯基,2020年)取得了超过"革命神经网络"(CNNs)的成果(LeCun等,1998年;Krizhevsky等,2012年;He等,2016年),长期以来一直是计算机视觉领域的实际标准.

blocks.en:
This success of ViT is largely attributed to the attention mechanism. Unlike CNNs, which structurally enforce a locality inductive bias ( Scherer et al., 2010 ; Schmidhuber, 2015 ; Bengio et al., 2017 ) , attention-based models are required to learn this property directly from data.
While this absence of structural constraints poses an additional learning challenge, the lack of bias grants the model the freedom to learn superior mechanisms from scratch.
Consequently, ViTs not only outperform CNNs in capturing long-range dependencies ( d’Ascoli et al., 2022 ; Edelman et al., 2022b ) but also exhibit advantageous emergent properties such as register tokens ( Darcet et al., 2023 ) that are absent in traditional CNNs.
blocks.zh:
ViT的这一成功主要归功于关注机制. 与有线电视新闻网在结构上强制实施局部诱导偏差(Sherer等,2010;Schmidhuber,2015;Bengio等,2017)不同,基于注意力的模型需要直接从数据中学习这种属性.
虽然这种缺乏结构制约的情况造成了额外的学习挑战,但缺乏偏见却使模式有从头开始学习优越机制的自由。
因此, ViTs不仅在捕捉远程依赖性方面表现优于CNN(d'Ascoli等,2022;Edelman等,2022b),而且还显示出了传统CNN所没有的诸如注册符等有利的新兴属性(Darcet等,2023).

blocks.en:
As inductive bias has played a pivotal role in the advancement of Transformers, some research have been dedicated to understanding the biases intrinsic to the architecture. Briefly, it has been observed that Transformers exhibit a structural bias toward symmetric functions ( Lavie et al., 2024 ) and tend to concentrate attention on a sparse subset of tokens ( Edelman et al., 2022a ) .
Despite these findings, the inductive bias imposed by the most fundamental structural choice of the Transformer, alternation of Attention and Feed-Forward Network (FFN), remains largely unexplored.
blocks.zh:
由于诱导偏差在"变形金刚"的推进中发挥了关键作用,一些研究致力于理解该架构所固有的偏差. 简而言之,据观察,变形金刚在结构上偏向对称功能(Lavie等,2024年),并倾向于将注意力集中在少量的代币上(Edelman等,2022a). 。 。 。 。
尽管有这些发现,变革者最根本的结构选择、注意力的交替和饲料展望网络(FFN)所施加的诱导性偏见基本上仍未被探讨。

blocks.en: Moreover, recent studies on Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) provide evidence that this “baked-in” alternating structure of Attention and FFN may not be indispensable ( Luo et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2024 ) . For instance, SkipGPT ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) trained a router to conditionally drop attention or FFN blocks, revealing that consecutive interactions (e.g., Attention-Attention or FFN-FFN) are occasionally more effective than the standard alternating pattern. These studies motivate an investigation into when the Attention–FFN structure in Transformers is necessary and when it may be redundant.
blocks.zh: 此外,最近关于专家混合研究的研究表明,这种“嵌入式”交替的注意结构与FFN可能并非不可或缺(Luo等人,2025年;Zhao等人,2025年;He等人,2025年;He等人,2024年)。 例如,SkipGPT(Zhao等,2025年)训练了路由器有条件地放下注意力或FFN块,揭示出连续的相互作用(如注意-注意或FFN-FFN)偶尔比标准交替模式更有效. 这些研究促使人们调查何时需要变形器中的注意-FFN结构,何时可能多余。

blocks.en: Given these observations, understanding the inductive bias imposed by the repeating Attention–FFN structure of the Transformer becomes crucial. Therefore, we aim to analyze this “Attention–FFN dichotomy” in ViT. To achieve this, (i) we formulate the AttenFeed module, a single component capable of exhibiting the properties of both Attention and FFN. (ii) Then we build the unified Vision Transformer (uViT) composed of a sequence of AttenFeed modules, thereby removing the strict Attention–FFN dichotomy. (iii) Lastly, we compare uViT with ViT to analyze under what circumstances and to what extent the conventional Attention–FFN dichotomy facilitates the learning process.
blocks.zh: 鉴于这些观点,理解 " 变形器 " 的 " 关注-FFN " 结构一再造成的诱导性偏见变得至关重要。 因此,我们的目的是分析VIT中的 " 意图-FFN " 二分法。 为此,(一)我们开发了AttenFeed模块,这是一个单一的组件,能够显示注意力和FFN的特性. (二)然后我们建造由AttenFeed模块序列组成的统一的Vision Transformer(uViT),从而去除严格的注意-FFN二分法. (三) 最后,我们将uViT与ViT作一比较,分析在什么情况下和在什么程度上常规的注意-FFN二分法促进学习过程.

blocks.en: To formulate the AttenFeed module, we start from the interpretation of UMoE ( Yang et al., 2025 ) that views the standard Attention as an FFN with no activation function. By incorporating a non-linear activation function into standard attention, we enable its interpretation as a conventional FFN. In Section 4.1 , we mathematically demonstrate that the AttenFeed module is a generalized form of both Attention and FFN. Then, in Sections 4.3 , 4.2 and 4.4 , we experimentally show that the AttenFeed module simultaneously possesses the properties of both Attention and FFN. These results confirm that AttenFeed relaxes the Attention–FFN dichotomy, subsuming the functionalities of both.
blocks.zh: 为了制定AttenFeed模块,我们从UMoE(Yang等,2025年)的解读开始,将标准关注视为一个没有激活功能的FFN. 通过将非线性活化功能纳入标准关注,我们得以将其解释为常规的FFN. 在第4.1节中,我们在数学上表明,AttenFeed模块是注意力和FFN的一种通用形式。 然后,在第4.3、4.2和4.4节中,我们实验地表明,AttenFeed模块同时具有注意和FFN的特性。 这些结果证实,AttenFeed放松了注意力-FFN的分化,将两者的功能归并了.

blocks.zh: 图1:建筑插图 . (a)显示一层标准变形器, (b)显示一层统一变形器,一种用于研究"注意-FFN"二分法的控制结构.

blocks.en: Next, we design uViT, an architecture composed of a sequence of AttenFeed modules (Figure 1 b). Since the AttenFeed module relaxes the structural inductive bias imposed by the Attention–FFN separation in conventional ViTs, we hypothesize that uViT exhibits weaker inductive bias than standard ViTs. We empirically validate this conjecture in Section 5.1 . Consequently, uViT serves as a control group for investigating the Attention–FFN dichotomy of ViTs, as it subsumes the functional properties of both Attention and FFN while relaxing the strict structural constraints.
blocks.zh: 接下来,我们设计了uViT,一个由AttenFeed模块序列(图1b)组成的架构. 由于AttenFeed模块放松了常规VITs中关注-FFN分离所施加的结构诱导偏差,我们假设uViT显示的诱导偏差比标准VITs更弱. 我们在第5.1节中从经验上证实了这种猜想。 因此,uViT是调查关注-FFN对ViTs的二分法的对照小组,因为它包含关注和FFN的功能特性,同时放松严格的结构限制。

blocks.en: Finally, we pretrain both ViT and uViT on various datasets and compare their performance in Section 5.2 . The results show that while uViT significantly outperforms ViT at smaller model scales, the performance gap between the two architectures narrows and becomes marginal as the model capacity increases. The experiments in Section 5 confirm that the inductive bias imposed by the Attention–FFN dichotomy in standard ViTs actually hinders performance at smaller scales.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们在各种数据集上对VIT和uViT进行预先培训,并在第5.2节中比较它们的性能. 结果显示,虽然uViT在较小的模型尺度上显著地超过ViT,但两种架构之间的性能差距会缩小并随着模型容量的增加而变得边缘. 第5节中的实验证实,在标准VITs中,由注意-FFN二分法所施加的诱导偏差实际上阻碍了较小尺度的性能.

blocks.en: The significance of our proposed AttenFeed module extends beyond the mere integration of standard Attention and FFN. Rather, it aims to open a new avenue for theoretically and empirically investigating the heuristically established alternating Attention–FFN structure of Transformers ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2023 ) . We anticipate that the AttenFeed module and uViT will facilitate a more systematic investigation into the architectural inductive biases that have long underpinned the success of ViT.
blocks.zh: 我们提议的AttenFeed模块的意义超越了仅仅将标准关注和FFN结合起来。 相反,它旨在开辟一条新的途径,从理论和经验角度调查 " 变形金刚 " 结构在理论上和实践中的交替存在(Wang等,2025;Yu等,2023)。 我们预计,AttenFeed模块和uViT将有助于更系统地调查长期以来支持ViT成功的建筑诱导偏差。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: ∘ \circ Formulation of the AttenFeed Module. We propose the AttenFeed module, a unified component mathematically and empirically proven to generalize the properties of both standard Attention and FFNs. ∘ \circ Introduction of uViT. We design the unified Vision Transformer (uViT) composed entirely of AttenFeed modules, effectively removing the strict Attention–FFN dichotomy of standard Transformers. ∘ \circ Analysis of Inductive Bias at Scale. Through experiments using uViT, we reveal that the conventional Attention–FFN dichotomy acts as a restrictive inductive bias that impedes effective learning at smaller model scales.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Inductive bias serves as a fundamental architectural constraint that guides a model toward a specific solution space. While these biases often accelerate early-stage training, they can arguably act as a bottleneck, limiting the performance ceiling when data becomes sufficiently large ( Bachmann et al., 2023 ; Dosovitskiy, 2020 ; Neyshabur et al., 2017 ; Sutton, 2019 ) . For instance, the Vision Transformer (ViT) ( Dosovitskiy, 2020 ) relaxes the image-specific inductive biases inherent in Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), such as translation equivariance and locality ( Scherer et al., 2010 ; Schmidhuber, 2015 ; Bengio et al., 2017 ) .
blocks.zh: 诱导性偏差是指导模型走向特定解决方案空间的基本建筑制约. 虽然这些偏差往往会加速早期培训,但可以说它们会成为瓶颈,在数据足够大时限制性能上限(Bachmann等,2023;Dosovitskiy,2020;Neyshabur等,2017;Sutton,2019)。 例如,视觉变形器(ViT)(Dosovitskiy,2020年)放松了革命神经网络(CNN)中固有的图像特有诱导偏差,如翻译等同和地(Sherer等,2010年;Schmidhuber,2015年;Bengio等,2017年).

blocks.en: As inductive bias has emerged as a key concept in understanding Transformer architectures, a growing body of literature has sought to characterize the specific biases that underpin Transformer performance. Transformers exhibit a structural bias toward symmetric functions ( Lavie et al., 2024 ) and tend to concentrate attention on a sparse subset of tokens ( Edelman et al., 2022a ) . From a task-specific perspective, the pairwise computation of self-attention inherently favors tasks requiring relational reasoning ( Sanford et al., 2023 ) . Furthermore, compared to State-Space Models (SSMs) ( Gu and Dao, 2024 ) , the structural bias of Transformers makes them more suitable for the copy task ( Jelassi et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 随着诱导性偏差作为理解"变形器"架构的关键概念而出现,越来越多的文献试图描述支撑变形器性能的具体偏差特征. 变形器在结构上偏向于对称功能(Lavie等,2024年),并倾向于将注意力集中在一小部分的活物上(Edelman等,2022a.). 从特定任务的角度来说,自觉的双向计算本质上有利于需要关系推理的任务(Sanford等,2023年). 此外,与国家空间模型(SSMs)(Gu和Dao,2024年)相比,变形器的结构偏差使其更适合复制任务(Jelassi等,2024年)。

blocks.en: Building upon these insights, subsequent research has focused on actively manipulating these biases to enhance training efficiency and performance ( Xu et al., 2021 ; Xiao et al., 2021 ; d’Ascoli et al., 2022 ) . For instance, Swin Transformer ( Liu et al., 2021 ) reintroduces locality and translation invariance through a hierarchical architecture and shifted window attention mechanism. Conversely, MLP-Mixer ( Tolstikhin et al., 2021 ) and ResMLP ( Touvron et al., 2023 ) minimize the inductive bias of token mixing by replacing self-attention with vanilla MLPs, demonstrating superior performance over standard Transformers on larger datasets. Beyond structural modifications, several studies ( Peruzzo et al., 2024 ; An et al., 2025 ) propose methods for injecting inductive biases during the training phase to enable more efficient training.
blocks.zh: 在这些见解的基础上,随后的研究侧重于积极操纵这些偏见,以提高培训效率和绩效(徐等,2021;萧等,2021;德阿斯科利等,2022)。 例如,Swin Transformer(Liu等,2021年)通过分级架构和转移窗口关注机制,重新引入了地方和翻译的偏差. 反之,MLP-Mixer(Tolstikhin等,2021年)和ResMLP(Touvron等,2023年)通过用香草MLP来取而代之,在较大的数据集上表现出优于标准变形器的性能来将信使混合的诱导偏差降到最低. 除了结构改造外,一些研究(Peruzzo等人,2024年;An等人,2025年)提出了在培训阶段注射诱导偏差的方法,以促成更有效的培训。

blocks.en: Despite these advancements, to the best of our knowledge, there is no research exploring the necessity of the rigid functional separation between Attention and FFN. While GAU ( Hua et al., 2022 ) attempts to merge GLU and Attention, it was primarily designed to compensate for the performance limitations of linear attention rather than to minimize inductive bias. We propose a unified module that generalizes both components, thereby enabling, for the first time, a systematic investigation of the Attention–FFN dichotomy.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进步,但据我们所知,没有研究探讨将注意力与FFN严格分开的必要性。 虽然GAU(Hua等,2022年)试图将GLU和"注意"合并,但其主要目的是补偿线性关注的性能限制,而不是将诱导偏差降到最低. 我们建议一个统一模块,将这两个部分概括起来,从而首次能够对关注-FFN二分法进行系统调查。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: The primary objective of this paper is to investigate when the inductive bias imposed by Attention–FFN structure becomes beneficial. To facilitate this investigation, we devise an architecture designed to relax this structural separation. Specifically, in Section 3.1 , we briefly review the conventional Vision Transformer (ViT) block. Next, in Section 3.2 , we introduce the AttenFeed module, a component that conceptually unifies Attention and FFN. Finally, in Section 3.3 , we present the overall unified Vision Transformer (uViT) architecture, designed to relax the explicit decoupling of Attention and FFN in ViT.
blocks.zh: 本文的主要目的是调查Regence-FFN结构所施加的诱导性偏见何时变得有益。 为了便利这次调查,我们设计了一个架构,旨在放松这种结构分离. 具体地说,在第3.1节中,我们简要地回顾了传统的远景变换器(ViT)块。 接下来,在第3.2节中,我们介绍了AttenFeed模块,这个组件概念上统一了注意力和FFN. 最后,在第3.3节中,我们介绍了总体统一的Vision Transformer(uViT)架构,旨在放松ViT中关注与FFN的明确脱钩.

blocks.en: 4 AttenFeed as a Generalization of Attention and FFN
blocks.zh: 页:1 作为关注的概况和论坛

blocks.en: In Section 4.1 , we mathematically demonstrate that the AttenFeed module generalizes both Attention and FFN. Furthermore, in Section 4.2 and Section 4.3 , we empirically show that the AttenFeed module exhibits the distinct characteristics of both Attention and FFN, respectively. Finally, in Section 4.4 , we reveal that the parameters 𝐖 V \mathbf{W}_{V} and 𝐖 O \mathbf{W}_{O} within the AttenFeed module converge to intermediate values between those of standard attention and standard FFN. Ultimately, these findings indicate that the AttenFeed module mitigates the inductive biases inherent in Attention–FFN separation, effectively inheriting the properties of both.
blocks.zh: 在第4.1节中,我们在数学上证明,AttenFeed模块既概括了注意力,又概括了FFN. 此外,在第4.2节和第4.3节中,我们的经验显示, " AttenFeed " 模块分别显示出注意力和FFN的独特特点。 最后,在第4.4节中,我们揭示出AttenFeed模块中的参数W V\mathbf{W}_{V}和W O\mathbf{W}_{O}在标准关注值和标准FFN值之间汇合到中间值. 归根结底,这些调查结果表明,AttenFeed模块减轻了关注-FFN分离中固有的诱导性偏见,有效地继承了两者的财产。

blocks.en: To empirically validate Proposition 4.1 , we examine whether the AttenFeed module exhibits the functional properties of an FFN. Specifically, we focus on the established observation that FFNs play a critical role in mitigating rank collapse within Transformers ( Dong et al., 2021 ; Jha and Reagen, 2026 ; Noci et al., 2022 ; Park and Kim, 2022 ) . Rank collapse refers to a phenomenon where the latent representations of different tokens become increasingly correlated as the network depth increases. This leads to “token uniformity,” where the model loses its expressivity because the features of distinct tokens become nearly indistinguishable. Models composed solely of attention layers are therefore known to exhibit a reduction in the rank of their representations ( Dong et al., 2021 ) .
blocks.zh: 为了从经验上验证提议4.1,我们审查AttenFeed模块是否显示出一个FFN的功能性能. 具体地说,我们关注的既定观点是,FFNs在减轻变形人内部军衔倒塌方面发挥关键作用(Dong等,2021;Jha和Reagen,2026;Noci等,2022;Park和Kim,2022)。 分级倒闭是指随着网络深度的增大,不同标志的潜在表现越来越相互关联的现象. 这导致了“托盘统一”,即由于不同标志的特征几乎无法区分,模型失去了其表达性。 因此,据了解,仅由关注层组成的模型表明其代表的级别有所下降(Dong等,2021年)。

blocks.en: As shown in Equation 4 , the AttenFeed module introduces a GELU activation into the attention mechanism. This modification endows the conventional attention mechanism with FFN-like properties ( Section 4.1 ). Thus, to empirically verify that AttenFeed module possesses FFN-like behavior, we compare the representational rank of uViT against a ViT variant in which the FFN is removed, resulting in a model composed solely of attention layers. We denote this FFN-removed ViT as xViT. Given that FFNs are known to play a pivotal role in preventing rank collapse, we hypothesize that xViT will exhibit a relatively lower rank. Conversely, we expect uViT to maintain a higher rank, as its AttenFeed modules are designed to integrate FFN-like functionalities.
blocks.zh: 如"方程式4"所显示,AttenFeed模块将GELU活化引入了关注机制. 这种修改使传统关注机制具有类似FFN的特性(第4.1节)。 因此,为了实证地验证AttenFeed模块拥有类似FFN的行为,我们比较了uViT的表示分级与ViT变体,其中FFN被去除,从而形成一个完全由关注层组成的模型. 我们表示这个FFN取消的VIT是xViT. 鉴于众所周知FFN在防止军衔倒塌方面起着关键作用,我们假设xViT会显示相对较低的军衔. 相反,我们期望uViT保持更高的地位,因为它 AttenFeed模块被设计为整合了类似FFN的功能.

blocks.en: First, we train xViT on a training set. Then, we freeze the model and record all the outputs of the [CLS] token on the associated validation set. Next, we measure the rank by performing Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) and counting the number of eigenvalues that account for 95% of the variance ( Roy and Vetterli, 2007 ; Denil et al., 2013 ) (for details, see Section C.1 ). This rank value is then divided by the maximum possible rank to present the normalized rank ( Yunis et al., 2024 ) . 3 3 3 For instance, given N N [CLS] token representations in ℝ N × d \mathbb{R}^{N\times d} , the maximum possible rank is d d ; thus, if the measured rank is r r , the normalized rank is computed as r / d r/d . Subsequently, we insert a GELU activation into the attention module of xViT to transform it into uViT, and repeat the identical procedure to measure its normalized rank. We use CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 ( Krizhevsky, 2009 ) as train datasets.
blocks.zh: 首先,我们训练XViT 在训练集。 然后,我们冻结模型,并将[CLS]符号的所有输出记录在相关的验证集上. 接下来,我们通过执行Singular Value分解(SVD)并计算占差异95%的等值(Roy and Vetterli, 2007;Denil等人,2013年)(详情见C.1节)。 这个军衔值再被尽可能最高的军衔相除,以显示已归正的军衔(Yunis等, 2024). 3 3 3 例如,由于N N [CLS] 在R N × d s\ mathbb{ R\ N\ times d} 中的符号表示, 可能达到的最高军衔为 d d d; 因此, 如果测量的军衔为 r r , 将归正的军衔计算为 r / d r/ d. 随后,我们将GELU活化法插入到xViT的注意力模块中,以将它转化为uViT,并重复同样的程序来测量它的正态级别. 我们使用CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100(Krizhevsky,2009年)作为列车数据集.

blocks.en: The experimental results are summarized in Table 6 . We define pre-head rank and post-head rank as the normalized ranks of representations immediately preceding and following the classification head. When comparing xViT and uViT under identical configurations, uViT consistently exhibits a higher output rank, which correlates with improved test accuracy. These trends remain robust across various datasets ( Appendix C ). Given that the only structural disparity between uViT and xViT is the presence of the GELU activation, these findings suggest that the non-linear function imparts FFN-like, rank-preserving properties to the AttenFeed module.

blocks.en: 4.3 Attention-like Behavior of AttenFeed Module
blocks.zh: 4.3 类似注意行为模块

blocks.en: To empirically validate Proposition 4.2 and 4.3 , we examine whether the AttenFeed module exhibits attention-like behavior through attention-based segmentation. Attention maps in ViTs visualize the salient image regions that the model focuses on when making predictions ( Dosovitskiy, 2020 ; Gao et al., 2021 ; Darcet et al., 2023 ) . These maps can therefore be leveraged to obtain segmentation masks for object regions ( Helbling et al., 2025 ; Chefer et al., 2021 ) . Thus, we assess whether the attention maps produced by ViT can also be utilized to generate meaningful segmentation masks.

blocks.en: 5 Impact of Inductive Bias in ViT
blocks.zh: 5. 诱导性偏见在ViT的影响

blocks.en: Unified Vision Transformer (uViT) consists of a sequence of AttenFeed modules, each capable of functioning as both Attention and FFN. Consequently, unlike the standard ViT, uViT is expected to be liberated from the inductive biases inherent in the conventional Attention–FFN dichotomy. In Section 5.1 , we experimentally demonstrate that uViT indeed possesses weaker inductive bias than ViT. Subsequently, in Section 5.2 , we compare the pretraining performance of uViT and ViT, showing that the Attention–FFN dichotomy in ViT has a detrimental effect on performance when the model size is small.
blocks.zh: 统一视觉变形器(uViT)由AttenFeed模块的序列组成,每个模块都能够同时作为注意力和FFN来运行. 因此,与标准VIT不同的是,uViT预计将摆脱传统关注-FFN二分法固有的诱导性偏见。 在5.1节中,我们实验地证明,uViT确实拥有比ViT更弱的诱导偏差. 随后,在第5.2节中,我们比较了uViT和ViT的预训性能,显示在ViT中的Content-FFN二分法在模型尺寸较小时对性能有不利影响.

blocks.en: 5.1 Assessing Inductive Bias via Transfer Learning
blocks.zh: 5.1 通过转移学习评估诱导性偏见

blocks.en: Table 4: Transfer learning performance comparison between ViT and uViT. The results include Top-1 accuracy (%) for linear probing and full fine-tuning across four downstream datasets (SVHN, CIFAR10, CIFAR100, and STL10).

blocks.en: uViT relaxes the strict separaration of Attention and FFN architecture in ViT. As a result, uViT is expected to exhibit less inductive bias than ViT and therefore holds the potential to learn more generalized representations ( Dosovitskiy, 2020 ) . To examine this hypothesis, we compare the transfer learning performance of pre-trained uViT and ViT on downstream datasets. If uViT indeed possesses less inductive bias than ViT, it should demonstrate better transfer performance than ViT.
blocks.zh: uViT在ViT中放宽了对注意力和FFN建筑的严格隔离. 因此,uViT预计将比ViT表现出较少的诱导偏好,因此具有学习更普遍表述的潜力(Dosovitskiy,2020.). 为了检查这个假说,我们比较了在下游数据集上预训uViT和ViT的转移学习性能. 如果uViT确实拥有比ViT更少的诱导偏差,它应该表现出比ViT更好的传输性能.

blocks.en: We further train ViT-S/B/L and uViT-S/B/L, which were pre-trained on ImageNet-1k as described in Section 4.3 , on the SVHN, CIFAR10, CIFAR100, and STL10 datasets ( Netzer et al., 2011 ; Krizhevsky, 2009 ; Coates et al., 2011 ) . For a fair comparison, all training hyperparameters were kept strictly identical (see Appendix B ). To evaluate the flexibility of the output representations of pre-trained models, we report the performance of training only the classification head (linear probing). In addition, to assess the flexibility of the model’s internal parameters, we present full fine-tuning results.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步培训ViT-S/B/L和uViT-S/B/L,如第4.3节所述,在ImageNet-1k、SVHN、CIFAR10、CIFAR100和STL10数据集(Netzer等,2011年;Krizhevsky,2009年;Coates等,2011年)上进行了预先培训。 为了进行公平的比较,所有训练超参数都完全相同(见附录B)。 为了评价预先训练过的模型产出表现的灵活性,我们只报告训练的成绩(线性测试)分类头. 此外,为了评估模型内部参数的灵活性,我们提出了全面的微调结果。

blocks.en: The experimental results are presented in Table 4 . uViT outperformed ViT across all evaluated scenarios for linear probing, and for full fine-tuning, uViT achieved superior performance in the majority of cases. These results indicate that both the output representations and the internal parameters of uViT possess greater flexibility when adapting to unseen datasets. These results provide strong evidence that uViT exhibits less inductive bias than ViT.
blocks.zh: 实验结果见表4. uViT在所有经评价的线性检测和全面微调情况下的ViT的性能都超过了ViT,在大多数情况下,uViT都取得了优异的性能. 这些结果表明,uViT的输出表示和内部参数在适应无形数据集时都具有更大的灵活性. 这些结果有力地证明了uViT表现出的诱导偏差比ViT少.

blocks.en: Finding of Section 5.1 : uViT exhibits less inductive bias imposed by the Attention–FFN dichotomy than ViT.
blocks.zh: 发现第5.1节:uViT显示的注意力-FFN二分法所施加的诱导偏差比ViT少.

blocks.en: 5.2 The Role of Inductive Bias at Scale
blocks.zh: 5.2 诱导性偏见的规模作用

blocks.en: Table 5: Pre-training performance across different model scales. uViT shows a significant performance advantage over ViT at the Small scale, while the gap narrows at the Base scale. † We doubled the batch size for the experiments, since convergence of uViT was unstable under the default setting.

blocks.en:
Section 4 shows that the AttenFeed module in uViT relaxes the Attention–FFN dichotomy in ViT, and Section 5.1 demonstrates that this leads to reduced inductive bias compared to ViT. Taken together, these findings indicate that uViT mitigates the inductive bias inherent in the Attention–FFN dichotomy.
Leveraging uViT as a control group for investigating the role of the Attention–FFN separation, we compare the pre-training performance of ViT and uViT to examine under what conditions the Attention–FFN dichotomy is beneficial. Our results show that the benefit of the Attention–FFN dichotomy in ViT diminishes as the model size decreases.
blocks.zh:
第4节表明,uViT中的AttenFeed模块放松了ViT中的"注意力-FFN"二分法,而第5.1节则表明,与ViT相比,这导致了感官偏差的减少. 总之,这些调查结果表明,uViT减轻了关注-FFN二分法固有的诱导性偏差。
利用uViT作为调查注意-FFN分离作用的控制小组,我们比较了ViT和uViT的训练前性能,以检查在什么条件下注意-FFN二分法是有利的. 我们的结果显示,VIT中关注-FFN二分法的好处随着模型大小的缩小而减少.

blocks.en: We pre-train the uViT-S/B/L and ViT-S/B/L on three larger-scale datasets: ImageNet-1k, Places365 ( Zhou et al., 2018 ) , and iNaturalist 2021 ( Van Horn et al., 2021 ) . The training procedure for all experiments is identical to the setup described in Section 4.3 .
blocks.zh: 我们在三个更大规模数据集上对uViT-S/B/L和ViT-S/B/L进行预训: ImageNet-1k, Places365 (周克等,2018年),和iNaturalist 2021 (Van Horn等,2021年). 所有实验的培训程序与第4.3节所述的设置相同。

blocks.en: The experimental results are presented in Table 5 . When the model size is Small, uViT significantly outperforms ViT. However, as the model scales from Small to Base, this performance gap diminishes substantially. Since ViT and uViT were trained under identical conditions, these performance differences arise from the structural dichotomy of Attention–FFN. Therefore, we interpret this diminishing performance gap as an indication that the Attention–FFN dichotomy in ViT becomes counterproductive at a smaller model scales.
blocks.zh: 实验结果见表5。 当模型大小为"小"时,uViT的性能明显地超过了"ViT". 然而,随着从小型到基地的模型尺度,这一业绩差距已大大缩小。 由于ViT和uViT是在相同条件下接受训练的,这些性能差异产生于"注意-FFN"的结构二分法. 因此,我们把这种日益缩小的性能差距解释为表明,在VIT中,注意-FFN的二分法在较小的模型尺度上变得适得其反。

blocks.en: We attribute the disadvantage of the Attention–FFN dichotomy at smaller scales to the rigid parameter allocation of ViT. Under the limited parameter budgets of small models, allocating parameters efficiently becomes critical. However, the strict separation between Attention and FFN forces parameters into fixed functional roles, which can lead to structural inefficiencies. For example, the standard architecture cannot dynamically allocate more capacity toward attention due to the fixed parameter budget assigned to the FFN, even when modeling token relationships is crucial for the dataset. In contrast, uViT provides architectural flexibility that allows limited parameters to be utilized more adaptively.
blocks.zh: 我们把较小尺度的注意-FFN二分法的缺点归因于VIT的刚性参数分配. 在小型模型的有限参数预算中,有效分配参数变得至关重要。 然而,将注意力和FFN部队参数严格区分为固定的职能作用,可能导致结构效率低下. 例如,由于给FFN分配的固定参数预算,标准架构无法动态地分配更多关注能力,即使建模符关系对数据集至关重要. 相形之下,uViT提供了建筑灵活性,允许有限的参数被更适应性地利用.

blocks.en: Finding of Section 5.2 : Attention–FFN dichotomy in ViT becomes detrimental at a smaller model.
blocks.zh: 发现第5.2节:注意-FFN在VIT中的分化在较小的模型中变得有害.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we revisit one of the most fundamental yet under-examined design choices in Vision Transformers: the rigid alternation between Attention and Feed-Forward Networks (FFNs). To analyze the necessity of this Attention–FFN dichotomy, we propose the AttenFeed module, a unified component that mathematically and empirically generalizes both standard attention and FFNs. Building upon this formulation, we introduce the unified Vision Transformer (uViT), which replaces the alternating structure with a sequence of AttenFeed modules, thereby relaxing the structural inductive bias imposed by explicit functional separation. Through theoretical analysis and extensive experiments, we demonstrate that the conventional Attention–FFN dichotomy acts as a restrictive inductive bias at smaller model scales.
The limitations of our study are discussed in Appendix D .
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们重温了"视觉变形器"中最根本,但未经充分考量的设计选择之一:"注意"和"Feed-Forward Networks"(FFNs)之间的僵硬交替. 为了分析这种关注-FFN二分法的必要性,我们提出AttenFeed模块,这个统一的组件在数学和经验上都概括了标准关注和FFN. 在这个提法的基础上,我们引入了统一的Vision Transformer(uViT),它用AttenFeed模块的序列来取而代之的交替结构,从而放松了由明显的功能分离所强加的结构导偏. 通过理论分析和广泛的实验,我们表明常规的"注意-FFN"二分法在较小的模型尺度上起到限制性的诱导偏差的作用.
附录D讨论了我们研究的局限性。

blocks.en: Impact Statement
blocks.zh: 影响说明

blocks.en: The models we analyze are pre-trained on large-scale image datasets (ImageNet-1k, Places365, iNaturalist-2021) known to contain geographic, taxonomic, and demographic imbalances; any downstream use of the resulting representations inherits these biases and should be subject to the fairness and robustness practices already established for pre-trained vision backbones. Beyond this, we are not aware of specific societal consequences of this work that require additional discussion.
blocks.zh: 我们分析的模型在大型图像数据集(ImageNet-1k, Places365, iNaturalist-2021)上进行了预先培训,已知这些模型包含地理、分类和人口失衡;对由此产生的表述的任何下游使用都继承了这些偏见,并应当服从为预先培训的愿景骨干已经建立的公平和有力的做法。 除此之外,我们不知道这项工作所产生的需要进一步讨论的具体社会后果。

blocks.en: Appendix B Training Details
blocks.zh: 附录B 培训详情

blocks.en:
We evaluate the proposed unified Vision Transformer ( uViT ) against the standard Vision Transformer ( ViT ) baseline at two scales:
(i) a toy-scale regime on small classification datasets used for our rank analyses ( Section 4.2 ), and
(ii) a large-scale pre-training regime on ImageNet-1k, Places365, and iNaturalist-2021.
In both regimes, every hyper-parameter that is not intrinsic to the architectural difference between ViT and uViT is held fixed, so that all observed differences can be attributed to the architectural change rather than to the optimization recipe.
blocks.zh:
我们根据标准Vision Transformer(ViT)基线,在两个尺度上评价拟议的统一Vision Transformer(uViT):
(一) 用于我们军衔分析的小分类数据集的玩具规模制度(第4.2节),以及
(二)关于ImageNet-1k,Places365和iNaturalist-2021的大规模预训制度.
在这两种制度下,VIT和uViT之间建筑差异所固有的每个超参数都是被固定的,这样所有观察到的差异都可以归因于建筑变化而不是优化配方.

blocks.en: B.1 Toy-Scale Training
blocks.zh: B.1 玩具规模培训

blocks.en:
Toy-scale experiments are conducted on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, STL-10, and SVHN. All images are resized to a common spatial resolution ( 32 × 32 32{\times}32 for CIFAR-10/100 and SVHN, 96 × 96 96{\times}96 for STL-10) and patchified with a patch size of 4 4 .
Training images are augmented with a random crop (padding 4 4 for CIFAR-10/100, STL-10 and padding 2 2 for SVHN), random horizontal flip (except SVHN, where flipping alters semantics), and RandAugment ( Cubuk et al., 2020 ) (CIFAR-10/100, STL-10 only).
Evaluation images are only resized and normalized using each dataset’s mean and standard deviation. Identical augmentation pipelines are applied to ViT and uViT.
blocks.zh:
在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、STL-10和SVHN上进行了玩具规模试验。 所有图像的大小被调整为共同空间分辨率(CIFAR-10/100和SVHN为32×32×32×32×32×32×32×32×32),STL-10为96×96×96×96×96×96×96等并用补丁大小为4 4.
培训图像增加了随机收成(CIFAR-10/100分4分,STL-10分和SVHN分2分),随机水平翻转(SVHN分出翻转改变语义)和RandAugment分出(Cubuk等,2020分出)(CIFAR-10/100分,STL-10分出)。
评价图像只使用每个数据集的平均值和标准偏差进行大小调整和正常化。 对VIT和uViT采用同种增强管.

blocks.en:
Large-scale pre-training is performed on ImageNet-1k, Places365-standard, and iNaturalist-2021 at an input resolution of 224 × 224 224{\times}224 with a patch size of 16 16 . For training, we apply a standard strong-augmentation pipeline: RandomResizedCrop ( 224 , scale = ( 0.08 , 1.0 ) ) (224,\,\text{scale}=(0.08,1.0)) , random horizontal flip with probability 0.5 0.5 , and RandAugment with magnitude 9 9 , followed by normalization with the ImageNet mean and standard deviation.
At the collate stage, each mini-batch is randomly transformed by either MixUp ( α mixup = 1.0 \alpha_{\text{mixup}}=1.0 ) ( Zhang et al., 2017 ) or CutMix ( α cutmix = 1.0 \alpha_{\text{cutmix}}=1.0 ) ( Yun et al., 2019 ) , yielding soft labels. Evaluation uses a single center crop: images are first resized to 256 256 pixels (short-side) and then center-cropped to 224 × 224 224{\times}224 . The same training and evaluation pipeline is used for ViT and uViT on every dataset.

The feature dimension is now C C , so ρ τ ​ ( 𝐙 post ) = r τ ​ ( 𝐙 post ) / C \rho_{\tau}(\mathbf{Z}^{\text{post}})=r_{\tau}(\mathbf{Z}^{\text{post}})/C . The two quantities probe complementary aspects of the learned representation. The pre-head rank measures how much of the embedding space is actively used by the backbone before classification; a low pre-head rank indicates that the backbone has collapsed distinct tokens into an overly narrow subspace, so that samples from different classes become difficult to separate linearly. The post-head rank, in contrast, measures how effectively the head spreads class-discriminative information across the available logit dimensions; a post-head rank well below 1 1 indicates that the logit output effectively operates on fewer than C C degrees of freedom, which is a direct symptom of confounded classes. Reporting both rank statistics thus allows us to localize rank collapse either to the backbone or to the classification stage.

C.2 Rank Preservation of AttenFeed Module
blocks.zh: C.2 军衔保护模块

blocks.en: In Section 4.2 , we empirically demonstrated on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 that the AttenFeed module inherits the rank-preserving behavior of FFNs. To verify that this finding is not specific to a particular dataset, we repeat the same experimental protocol on two additional small-scale datasets, SVHN ( Netzer et al., 2011 ) and STL-10 ( Coates et al., 2011 ) , which differ considerably from CIFAR in visual statistics (digit crops and high-resolution natural images, respectively). For each dataset, xViT (a ViT variant in which the FFN is removed) and uViT are trained under identical conditions at three matched ( L , H , D ) (L,H,D) configurations, and the normalized ranks of the [CLS] token representations immediately preceding and following the classification head (pre-head and post-head) are measured via SVD with the 95% variance threshold. The results are summarized in Table 6 .
blocks.zh: 在第4.2节中,我们在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上以经验证明,AttenFeed模块继承了FFN的保级行为. 为了证实这一发现并非特定数据集所特有的,我们重复了另外两个小型数据集的同一项实验协议,即SVHN(Netzer等,2011年)和STL-10(Coates等,2011年),它们在视觉统计(数字作物和高分辨率自然图像)上与CIFAR有很大不同. 对于每个数据集,xViT(一个删除FFN的ViT变体)和uViT在相同条件下以相匹配的3个配置(L,H,D (L,H,D))进行训练,在分类头前和后相邻的[CLS]符号表示(前头和后头)的正阶通过95%相差阈值的SVD来测量. 调查结果汇总于表6。

blocks.en: Table 6: Performance and representation rank comparison on SVHN and STL10. uViT consistently matches or exceeds xViT in pre-head rank and test accuracy, confirming that the rank-preserving behavior of the AttenFeed module generalizes beyond CIFAR-10/100.

blocks.en: Across every configuration, uViT attains a pre-head rank that is equal to or higher than that of xViT, and this higher rank is consistently accompanied by higher test accuracy. The advantage is especially pronounced on STL-10, where uViT improves the pre-head rank by up to 0.081 0.081 and the test accuracy by up to 3.20 3.20 percentage points over xViT. On SVHN, where both models nearly saturate due to the relative simplicity of the task, the rank and accuracy margins are smaller but still favor uViT. These observations replicate the CIFAR-10/100 trend reported in the main text and reinforce our conclusion that the GELU activation in the AttenFeed module imparts FFN-like rank-preserving properties independent of the target dataset.

blocks.en: C.3 Attention Map Comparison of uViT and ViT
blocks.zh: C.3. uViT和ViT的注意图比较

blocks.en: To complement the quantitative segmentation scores reported in Section 4.3 , we present additional qualitative comparisons of the attention maps produced by ViT-B and uViT-B in the figure below. Across a wide variety of object categories and scene compositions, uViT consistently attends to the salient object regions identified by ViT, with only minor deviations in spatial extent. This qualitative agreement extends the main-text finding to a broader set of images and further supports Propositions 4.2 and 4.3 .

blocks.en: Figure 4: Qualitative comparison of attention maps between ViT and uViT. uViT-B reliably highlights the same salient object regions as ViT-B, supporting the attention-like behavior of the AttenFeed module.

blocks.en: C.4 Parametric Space Comparison of uViT and ViT
blocks.zh: C.4 uViT和ViT的参数空间比较

blocks.en: Section 4.4 in the main text shows that, for the Base-scale models, the values of 𝐖 V \mathbf{W}_{V} and 𝐖 O \mathbf{W}_{O} in the AttenFeed module lie in an intermediate regime between the corresponding parameters of standard attention ( 𝐖 V \mathbf{W}_{V} , 𝐖 O \mathbf{W}_{O} ) and those of the FFN ( 𝐖 in \mathbf{W}_{\text{in}} , 𝐖 out \mathbf{W}_{\text{out}} ) in ViT. Here, we examine whether this transitional behavior also holds at the Small and Large scales. The layer selection, plotting procedure, and normalization are kept identical to the main-text protocol; the only difference is the model scale. The results are shown in the two figures below, corresponding to the Small and Large configurations, respectively.

blocks.en: At both scales, the uViT weight distributions are systematically wider than those of ViT’s attention parameters ( 𝐖 V \mathbf{W}_{V} , 𝐖 O \mathbf{W}_{O} ) yet narrower than those of ViT’s FFN parameters ( 𝐖 in \mathbf{W}_{\text{in}} , 𝐖 out \mathbf{W}_{\text{out}} ), reproducing the intermediate-regime pattern observed for the Base model. The consistency of this pattern across Small, Base, and Large models indicates that the unified character of the AttenFeed module is a scale-agnostic property of the architecture rather than an artifact of a specific capacity. This provides additional empirical support for our claim that the AttenFeed module simultaneously inherits the parametric tendencies of both the attention and FFN components of a standard Transformer.
blocks.zh: 在两种尺度上,uViT的重量分布都比ViT的注意参数(W V\mathbf{W}_{V},W O\mathbf{W}_{O})系统更宽,但比ViT的FFN参数(W in\mathbf{W}_{\text{in}},Wout\mathbf{W}_{\text{out}}})更窄,复制了为Base模型所观察到的中间机制模式. 这种图案横跨"小","基地","大"等模型的一致性表明,"AttenFeed"模块的统一特性是建筑的尺度可知性,而不是具有特定容量的文物. 这为我们关于AttenFeed模块同时继承标准变形器的注意力和FFN组件的参数化倾向的说法提供了更多的经验支持.

blocks.en: Appendix D Limitation
blocks.zh: 附录D 限制

blocks.en: While this work provides theoretical and empirical insights into the Attention-FFN dichotomy through the proposed AttenFeed module and uViT architecture, we acknowledge a few limitations that warrant future investigation.
blocks.zh: 虽然这项工作通过拟议的AttenFeed模块和uViT架构,为关注-FFN二分法提供了理论和经验上的见解,但我们承认一些局限性值得今后进行调查。

blocks.en: First, our empirical analysis is currently confined to the computer vision domain. Although the Transformer was originally designed for natural language processing and has since become a universal architecture across various modalities, our experiments strictly evaluate Vision Transformers (ViTs) on image datasets. The inductive biases imposed by the Attention-FFN separation may manifest differently in other domains, such as language modeling or audio processing. Validating the necessity of the Attention-FFN dichotomy and the efficacy of the AttenFeed module in these non-vision domains remains an important direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 首先,我们的经验分析目前仅限于计算机视觉领域。 虽然"变形器"最初是为自然语言处理而设计的,后来成为了跨越不同模式的通用架构,但我们的实验严格评价了影像数据集上的"视觉变形器"(ViTs). 关注-FFN分离带来的诱导性偏差在其他领域可能表现不同,例如语言建模或音频处理等. 验证注意-FFN二分法的必要性以及AttenFeed模块在这些非视觉领域的效力,仍然是今后工作的一个重要方向。

blocks.en: Second, to ensure a strictly fair comparison between uViT and the standard ViT, all models in our experiments were trained under identical conditions using a standard ViT training recipe. However, since uViT fundamentally alters the conventional network structure by unifying Attention and FFN into a single sequence of AttenFeed modules, it may possess a distinct optimal optimization landscape. Developing a specialized training recipe tailored to uViT—such as exploring different regularization techniques, learning rate schedules, or data augmentations—could potentially unlock further performance gains and alter the scaling behaviors observed in our current findings.
blocks.zh: 二,为确保uViT与标准ViT之间的严格公平比较,我们实验中的所有模型都是在相同条件下使用标准ViT培训配方进行训练的. 然而,由于uViT通过将"注意"和FFN统一为AttenFeed模块的单一序列,从根本上改变了常规网络结构,因此它可能拥有一个独特的最优化地貌. 开发适合uViT的专门培训配方——例如探索不同的规范化技术、学习进度表或数据扩充——可能进一步释放业绩收益并改变我们目前的调查结果所观察到的升级行为。
